items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Right here in the one from Ball Bonds. ... [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, that's my first lessons.

ctx.x: How old were you when you left Baton Rouge? I was quite a little bit. Teenage. Teenage. Yeah. So Guy Kelly started pretty young, wasn't he? Yes, he did. Did you take lessons in Baton Rouge? No, no.
Right here in the one from Ball Bonds. From Ball Bonds?

Yeah, that's my first lessons. Mm-hmm. What instrument? Oh, saxophone. Altho, a tenor? Altho. You always talk to Altho? I always talk to Altho and I played tenor, but Papa Sutherstein, soprano. Let's go back to the bands you, the very first bands you played with here.
